verified_pass_a.finding: REVIEW-r4a #15 (WAL checkpoint: every close does a best-effort checkpoint, no election)
verified_pass_a.result: CONFIRMED. closeDB() always runs db.pragma("wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)") in a try/catch, unconditionally. No counter, lock, or election. Q6/ADR-0002/GP8 text describing a 'last writer' election must be rewritten to 'every close attempts a checkpoint, best-effort' per this commit, matching the finding exactly.

verified_pass_a.finding: REVIEW-r4a #4 (PostToolUse never fires for the plugin's own MCP tools; server must self-emit journal rows)
verified_pass_a.result: CONFIRMED, and the quote is exact. Commit 320ed3e5 states the root cause in its own body: 'PostToolUse never fires for the plugin's OWN MCP tools, so the hook-side extractMcpToolCall path never observes ctx_search / ctx_fetch_and_index... This is a server-emit fix, not a hook-extract fix.' ADR-0009 must add a server-side journal-write path for ctx_execute/ctx_search/ctx_fetch_and_index/ctx_index, not rely on PostToolUse.

new_findings.text: REVIEW-r4a blocker #1 (tool count) and blocker #2 (Codex install mode) are STILL UNFIXED as of this review: grep of README.md/TECH-SPEC.md/PRD-v2.md still shows TECH-SPEC.md:289 GP1 row saying '7 tools' against TECH-SPEC.md:215/409 saying 9 tools kept; and ADR-0011/0013 still describe Codex plugin-marketplace install while PRD-v2.md:179 (E25) requires plain config.toml. Neither doc edit from REVIEW-r4a/BOTTLENECKS-r4 has landed. Pass B should not re-report these as new, but M0 cannot start with GP1's test row contradicting its own install step.

.claude/skills/release/SKILL.md step 2 still runs 'npm ci && npm run build' as found in BOTTLENECKS/REVIEW r4a item 11 — still present verbatim. Also confirms BOTTLENECKS-r4 item 3: PRD-v2.md still has no edit at lines 84/173 for the doctor CLI text (not independently re-checked by me beyond grep, flagged as still-open not new).

m0_plan_from_docs_alone: 1. Storage layer: single context.db per project (ADR-0002), node:sqlite, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, WAL checkpoint-on-every-close (per verified finding above), retention = age + live PID + size cap (Q7). BLOCKED on corruption policy (rename-only, never delete) and schema migration (PRAGMA user_version) before writing any code that opens this file in a multi-writer context.
2. Tool surface: 9 ctx_ tools incl. ctx_doctor/ctx_upgrade as MCP-tool-only (no CLI). BLOCKED on fixing the '7 tools' GP1 row before writing the GP1 test.

3. Routing/hooks (ADR-0008): deny-only for curl/wget/HTTP, shell-wrapper unwrap (sudo/env/time/nice/timeout/xargs/command/bash -c/$()), 16,384 B global output cap (Q2), Bash PostToolUse extraction PLUS server-side self-emit for the plugin's own MCP tools (verified finding #4).
4. Hook runtime (GS6): needs a resolved number plain Node can hit, or an explicit named exception for Bun-then-Node, before the GP3 bench test can be written as pass/fail.
5. Release pipeline (ADR-0013): needs concurrency guard + staging step before M0's e2e/release.yml is built, and SKILL.md step 2 needs the real no-npm command first.
6. Codex install path: needs E25 vs ADR-0011/0013 resolved (config.toml vs plugin-marketplace) before writing the Codex adapter install code.

questions.question: ADR-0002 still has no corruption clause for the shared context.db. Confirm the exact rule to implement in M0: on SQLITE_CORRUPT, which single process renames the file aside (the 'last writer' from Q6, or whoever hits the error first), and what do the OTHER already-open writer handles do on their next write — retry-reopen, or hard-fail and tell the agent to restart?
questions.why: Cannot write the DB-open code path without this; a wrong guess risks the exact data-wipe BOTTLENECKS-r4 #2 warns about.

questions.question: Q10 ties minimum Node to 'the first version with node:sqlite and timeout, no flag,' set by the S-NODE spike. Has that spike produced a version number yet? If not, what do I pin in package.json/CI matrix for M0 so the build isn't blocked?
questions.why: Without a concrete version, the CI matrix and install docs cannot be written.

questions.question: No PRAGMA user_version or migration step exists anywhere in ADR-0002/TECH-SPEC (BOTTLENECKS-r4 #5). For M0's first schema, do I just set user_version=1 and write a no-op migration runner now, or is schema versioning explicitly out of scope for M0 and deferred to M1?
questions.why: Determines whether M0 needs a migration module or can skip it.

questions.question: BOTTLENECKS-r4 #1: bare Node (45.6ms p95) already exceeds the 40ms GS6 budget, so today the only way to pass GS6 is a Bun-then-Node fallback, which violates 'no fallback chains.' Which of the three fixes in BOTTLENECKS-r4 #1 does the owner want for M0 — raise the budget, hard-require Bun, or name Bun-then-Node as the one explicit exception?
questions.why: GP3's bench test cannot be written until this is picked; blocks all hook-runtime code.

questions.question: #1261 (55-70ms CPU per hook, still open, no fixing commit in cm-main) needs an async PostToolUse mechanism per BOTTLENECKS-r4 #4. Is 'detached spawn, host does not wait on stdout' the actual mechanism to build for M0, and does the server-side self-emit path (verified finding #4 above) need to happen BEFORE or independent of this async dispatch change?
questions.why: These two mechanisms touch the same hook code path; building them in the wrong order could reintroduce the bug #4 just fixed.

questions.question: ADR-0007 decision 4 ('never read identity off the connection') contradicts the live v1 fix for #542/#539 which reads the SDK's initialize-time clientInfo cache (REVIEW-r4a #3, verified by citation but I have not re-run git log myself). For M0, do I implement decision 4 literally (and accept #542/#539 regress), or implement the scoped version (allow reading initialize-time clientInfo only, never live connection state)?
questions.why: This is a security rule with a direct implementation fork; guessing wrong either reopens a shipped bug or ships a rule violation.

questions.question: BOTTLENECKS-r4 #7 (no concurrency guard, no staging step in release.yml) has been flagged twice before with the same fix and still has 0 concurrency: block. Is this now an accepted fix to implement in M0 as-is (concurrency group + staging ref + smoke-before-fast-forward), or is there an owner objection I haven't seen that's holding it up?
questions.why: If it's simply unimplemented rather than disputed, M0 should just build it; if disputed, I need the real constraint.

questions.question: PRD-v2.md:179 (E25) requires Codex to install via plain config.toml, but ADR-0011/0013/README still describe a plugin-marketplace flow verified live in the v1 spike ('Upgraded 1'). For M0's Codex adapter, do I build the config.toml writer per E25, and if so what happens to the live-verified plugin-marketplace smoke test in ADR-0013 — removed entirely, or kept as a second, non-default install path?
questions.why: Determines the actual Codex adapter code and whether the release smoke job needs one install path or two.
